label: These legs crossed a committed bound and stay failing; only Carl resets one.

legs.note: the committed relative bound of 1e-12 on the round trip is below what a double can hold for a 1.42 GHz frequency: the spacing of doubles there is 2.4e-7 Hz, which is 5.0e-11 km/s of velocity, so the error relative to the smallest velocity tested (6.1 km/s) cannot be under about 8e-12. The kernel is at that floor. Left failing; a bound of 1e-10 km/s absolute would be the achievable one, and only Carl resets it
